sourceFile: 45. BRS-161014 DT Report test VP improve NG bending after lazer cutting of vender Alpha    date 21.6.2024_clean.xlsx

aiVerification.summary: Draft captures a comparable validation report but misgroups factors and omits key outcome rows.
issues: Changed factor mixes mold numbers, totals, and time conditions.
Mold and 1Hr/2Hr conditions are not preserved as subgroup keys.
Material and function outcomes omit #8/#10, totals, and Normal rows.
Sheet1 duplicate table is treated as separate unknown outcome.
Header-only measurement stats are not valid final evidence.
requiredUserQuestions: Should time condition be primary and mold number be subgroup?
correctionPlan: Define one validation context for post-laser VP bending improvement at vendor Alpha.
Use Normal as baseline and 1Hr/150C vs 2Hr/150C as changed conditions with mold as subgroup.
Include all relevant rows for material, vision, function, totals, Normal, and decisions.
Remove duplicate Sheet1 unknown outcome unless used only as cross-check.
Replace header-derived measurement stats with row-level defect metrics.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Row citations exist but are incomplete and include weak header/duplicate evidence.
